summary: Iteration 18: tested new Chain tab (live Tradier option chain + strategy builder) and new OptiIQ value model. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass across chain templates, expirations, chain rows, template builder, analyze (with validation), OptiIQ shape across AAPL/MSFT/KO/JPM(bank)/MRNA, and screener/ticker-options regression. Frontend: Chain tab visible as 6th tab, loads AAPL with 'Live · Tradier' badge, 23 expiration chips, tap c-ask-<strike> adds a leg, Strategy view shows pnl-chart + pnl-heatmap, Iron Condor template fills 4 legs, qty-plus/remove-leg/clear-legs all working, expiration switch clears legs, MSFT ticker search works. Analyze → Long-term AAPL shows optiiq-card with ONLY optiiq-value ($266.14) + optiiq-upside (-22.5% vs price) tag; no breakdown/explanation inside the card. No deprecated expo packages detected in files_of_reference.
critical_code_review_comments: chain.py: /chain/{ticker} GET route is declared after /chain/{ticker}/expirations - FastAPI matches by registration order so this is correct, but ordering is fragile. Consider explicit path separation.
chain.py: _exp() rejects malformed dates but accepts any valid ISO date including expirations not listed by Tradier; load_chain surfaces a 502 for those (acceptable but could be 404).
chain.py: analyze_position recomputes expirations/chain but only uses atm_iv as default - fine; just note the extra Tradier round-trip even when every leg already has iv.
chain.tsx (357 LOC) is still under the 700-line limit but combines screen + table + builder; could be split as it grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run chain/analyze tests serially (`-n 0`) because parallel xdist workers hit Finnhub’s 60/min cap and surface spurious 404 'No live quote' errors. Tradier is NOT rate-limited the same way (6-wide semaphore + 60s cache). stock-analysis response is nested under d['result']. OptiIQ response shape is strictly {available, value, price, upside_pct} with optional 'reason' when unavailable.
rca_of_issue: No regressions found. Initial run failed due to (a) parallel xdist Finnhub 429s causing /chain/{ticker}/expirations to 404 on spot-quote fetch, and (b) tests looking at d['optiiq'] when the server wraps the payload under d['result']['optiiq']. Both were test-script issues and were fixed.
